outcomes: This feature implements a continuous delivery pipeline for the FODMAP Fácil mobile application using Expo Application Services (EAS) Build and GitHub Actions. The system enables automated builds for development, preview, and production environments, with secure environment variable management and automated submission to TestFlight and Google Play Internal Testing.

requirements.text: THE EAS Build System SHALL provide three distinct build profiles named "development", "preview", and "production"
WHEN a development build is requested, THE EAS Build System SHALL include development tools and use development environment variables
WHEN a preview build is requested, THE EAS Build System SHALL create a distributable build suitable for internal testing
WHEN a production build is requested, THE EAS Build System SHALL create an optimized build suitable for app store submission
WHERE the iOS platform is selected, THE EAS Build System SHALL configure appropriate provisioning profiles and bundle identifiers for each profile
THE Environment Management System SHALL store sensitive environment variables using Expo's secure environment variable system
THE Environment Management System SHALL provide a template file (.env.example) that documents all required environment variables without exposing actual values
WHEN a build is executed, THE EAS Build System SHALL inject the appropriate environment variables for the selected profile
THE Environment Management System SHALL prevent committing actual .env files to version control through .gitignore configuration
THE Environment Management System SHALL support Kiro secrets integration for local development environment variables
THE Build Command Interface SHALL provide a single command that triggers a preview build for both iOS and Android platforms
WHEN the preview build command is executed, THE EAS Build System SHALL automatically select the preview profile configuration
THE Build Command Interface SHALL display build progress and provide a shareable URL upon completion
THE Build Command Interface SHALL complete the preview build process within 20 minutes under normal conditions
IF the build fails, THEN THE EAS Build System SHALL provide clear error messages indicating the failure reason
THE GitHub Actions Workflow SHALL execute linting checks on every pull request
THE GitHub Actions Workflow SHALL execute the complete test suite on every pull request
WHEN all tests pass on the main branch, THE GitHub Actions Workflow SHALL automatically trigger a preview build
THE GitHub Actions Workflow SHALL fail the CI pipeline if linting errors are detected
THE GitHub Actions Workflow SHALL fail the CI pipeline if any test fails
WHEN a production build completes successfully, THE Submission System SHALL automatically submit the iOS build to TestFlight
WHEN a production build completes successfully, THE Submission System SHALL automatically submit the Android build to Google Play Internal Testing
THE Submission System SHALL require explicit approval before submitting to production tracks
THE Submission System SHALL provide submission status notifications through GitHub Actions
IF submission fails, THEN THE Submission System SHALL log detailed error information for troubleshooting
THE Release Documentation SHALL provide a step-by-step checklist for creating releases
THE Release Documentation SHALL include version bumping procedures following semantic versioning
THE Release Documentation SHALL document the process for creating and pushing git tags
THE Release Documentation SHALL explain how to monitor build status and troubleshoot common issues
THE Release Documentation SHALL include rollback procedures for failed releases
THE Build Status Badge SHALL display the current status of the main branch CI/CD pipeline
WHEN the CI/CD pipeline is passing, THE Build Status Badge SHALL display a green "passing" indicator
WHEN the CI/CD pipeline is failing, THE Build Status Badge SHALL display a red "failing" indicator
THE Build Status Badge SHALL link directly to the GitHub Actions workflow runs page
THE Build Status Badge SHALL update automatically within 5 minutes of workflow completion
